name: codeguard-ai-scanning
description: Autonomous AI agent for VS Code: reviews your project, fixes bugs, runs your tests to verify the fixes, and reports what changed. Powered by NVIDIA Nemotron on Nebius Token Factory.

codeguard.apiKey.markdownDescription: API key (fallback). Prefer the command **CodeGuard: Set API Key**, which stores the key encrypted in VS Code SecretStorage.

codeguard.model.description: Model ID used for the review (copy the exact ID from your provider's model page).

codeguard.deepModel.description: Optional stronger model. CodeGuard switches to it when the tests keep failing after fixes. Leave empty to disable.

codeguard.testCommand.markdownDescription: Command used to verify fixes. Leave empty to auto-detect (`npm test` if package.json has a test script).

codeguard.requireApproval.description: Show a diff and ask before each fix is applied.

codeguard.disableThinking.description: Turn off the model's extended thinking for faster, cheaper tool calls (NVIDIA Nemotron chat template option).

codeguard.tavilyApiKey.markdownDescription: Optional Tavily key (fallback). Prefer **CodeGuard: Set Tavily API Key**. Enables web search for uncertain fixes.
